name: en-us-academic
about: American English academic prose without formulas (#124): correct American sentences that a proofreader told to keep British spelling may 'fix' (color, center, analyzed, traveled, program, license, -ize), British spellings that are errors in en-US, and a few typical grammar errors. The same form as academic-en-gb.json: errors[].wrong is the wrong text (its first occurrence), kind is grammar / spelling / punctuation, ok lists fragments of which the text must contain one once the suggested fix is put in; errors: [] means a correct text, where every finding is a false alarm. source: made = written for this set.
